generatedFrom: regex extraction over server.js + memory/routes.js + preview/routes.js + typecheck/routes.js + auth/google.js + auth/github.js (the route inventory), merged with a hand-authored DOCUMENTED registry (purpose/request/response/curl) cross-checked against it

appWideMiddleware.statement: The actual per-request authorization gate: wraps every /api/* route except /api/auth/* with auth.requireAuth, but only when enforceAuth is true (authConfigProblems().length === 0 — real Google client id/secret, a real >=32-char JWT_SECRET, and a non-empty ALLOWED_EMAILS, evaluated once at module load).
appWideMiddleware.distinctFrom: bootPosture (server.js:82) — a separate, boot-time check that can process.exit(1) before the server ever binds if unconfigured auth is combined with a non-loopback HOST. This middleware is the per-request enforcement; bootPosture is the boot-time refusal.

endpoints.purpose: Returns today's per-model request/token usage counters plus the configured daily quota limits and default model ids.
endpoints.notes: No model call; reads/writes in-memory quotaState, persisted to logs/quota.json.

endpoints.purpose: Lists every usable model (provider has a configured key) with capabilities/pricing/daily limit, plus per-task defaults.
endpoints.notes: No model call — filters providers/catalog.js's CATALOG by configured env keys.

endpoints.purpose: Streams a single-turn plain-text chat reply from the default (or requested) chat model.
endpoints.response: 200 text/plain streamed chunks; 400 {message} if prompt missing; 500 {message} on failure before any bytes sent.
endpoints.curl: curl -N -X POST http://localhost:8050/api/chat-stream -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"Write a haiku about databases"}'
endpoints.notes: Single provider.streamChat call at effort 'low', maxOutputTokens 4096.

endpoints.purpose: Edits an uploaded image per a text prompt using Gemini's image model.
endpoints.response: 200 JSON array of parts [{text?}|{imageUrl?: data URL}]; 400/500 {message}.
endpoints.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8050/api/edit-image -F 'file=@photo.png' -F 'prompt=Make the background sunset orange'
endpoints.notes: Multer in-memory upload. Calls @google/genai directly, not through providers/ — feature flagged off in the UI.

endpoints.purpose: Starts asynchronous video generation (optionally image-to-video) via Veo, returns an operation name to poll.
endpoints.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8050/api/generate-video -F 'prompt=A drone shot over a neon city'
endpoints.notes: Direct @google/genai call; client must poll /api/video-status.

endpoints.purpose: Polls a Veo operation and, once complete, downloads and returns the finished video inline as a base64 data URL.
endpoints.notes: Re-downloads and base64-inlines the whole video server-side on each completed poll.

endpoints.purpose: Streams a multi-turn coding-assistant reply, including tool calls and optional web-search grounding, as NDJSON.
endpoints.request: {history?, projects?, persona?, useWebSearch?, customStyles?, lowLatencyMode?, model?, mode?}.
endpoints.curl: curl -N -X POST http://localhost:8050/api/coding-chat-stream -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"history":[{"author":"user","parts":[{"text":"How do I center a div?"}]}]}'
endpoints.notes: Routed provider-agnostically through providers/, unlike chat-stream/edit-image/video.

endpoints.purpose: Proxies an npm registry search, returning up to 5 matches.
endpoints.notes: No model call; plain fetch against registry.npmjs.org.

endpoints.purpose: Asks the coding model to summarize libraries/frameworks apparent across provided source files.
endpoints.notes: Single generateText call against MODELS.coding.

endpoints.purpose: Generates (or, given previousPlan+feedback, revises) a structured project plan from a one-line idea.
endpoints.response: 200 PLAN_SCHEMA {projectName, projectDescription, pages, components, acceptanceCriteria, entities}; 500 {message}.
endpoints.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8050/api/builder/plan -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"idea":"A recipe sharing app"}'
endpoints.notes: Structured-output call via withModelFallback over the builder model chain; memory event fires after the response is sent, never on the critical path.

endpoints.purpose: Proposes exactly three distinct art directions (palette + typography) for the theme step.
endpoints.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8050/api/builder/directions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"idea":"A recipe sharing app"}'
endpoints.notes: Same fallback-chain pattern as /plan; recall runs with directionGeneration:true, excluding taste lessons.

endpoints.purpose: The generation pipeline entry point: manifest-then-per-file, streaming progress, then a compiler-driven repair pass.
endpoints.response: Streaming application/x-ndjson — phase/manifest/file/progress lines, then a final line with files/manifest/missing/repair stats; 500 {message} before any bytes, or a final {error} NDJSON line mid-stream.
endpoints.notes: See harness-agentic-loop.json for the repair-round mechanics — this is the pipeline the generation-pipeline audit is about.

endpoints.purpose: Has the model self-report, per acceptance criterion, whether the generated files satisfy it — a labelled self-check, never a gate.
endpoints.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8050/api/builder/check-acceptance -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"plan":{"acceptanceCriteria":["Users can view recipes"]},"files":{}}'
endpoints.notes: Every message suffixed '(self-reported...not independently verified)'; never in memory/proposals.js's PROPOSAL_TABLE.

endpoints.purpose: The peer-programmer edit: applies a natural-language instruction to an existing project, returns only changed files merged over the current set, then typechecks.
endpoints.request: {files, plan?, diagnostics?, instruction (required), model?, buildId?, episodeId?}.
endpoints.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8050/api/builder/edit -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"files":{},"instruction":"Add a heading"}'
endpoints.notes: Single structured-output call at effort 'high', then a real tsc run — no browser preview at this route.

endpoints.purpose: Liveness probe that also reports whether the /api surface is currently enforcing authentication.
endpoints.notes: Mounted outside /api so a liveness probe never needs a session.

endpoints.purpose: Opens (or rejoins an already-open matching) memory episode, or a no-op null id if memory is unavailable.
endpoints.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8050/api/memory/episodes/open -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"buildId":"build-123","objective":"plan a recipe app"}'
endpoints.notes: Bounded to 2s; never gates the builder — the route only ever answers 200.

endpoints.purpose: Closes an episode with a final outcome and checks whether any lessons it used now qualify for promotion.
endpoints.notes: The promotion ratchet lives here: a lesson only counts toward promotion once the attempt that used it closes 'verified'.

endpoints.purpose: Batch-records builder lifecycle events plus evidence, and derives lesson proposals from failed verdicts.
endpoints.response: 200 {accepted, accepted_ids, rejected, evidenceIds, proposed}; an unrecognized kind lands in rejected, never an HTTP error.
endpoints.notes: Only verification.completed events can produce proposals, via memory/proposals.js's declared table — no model involved.

endpoints.purpose: Reports memory-engine health and, given a buildId, that build's episode/lesson/evidence/event counts.
endpoints.notes: probe() forces the engine to actually load before answering.

endpoints.purpose: The human gate: promotes a qualified lesson to 'approved' under a named approver.
endpoints.notes: Reachable from no prompt or tool schema — no model can approve its own lesson.

endpoints.purpose: Bundles a generated project with esbuild and compiles its CSS into one self-contained HTML document for the sandboxed iframe preview.
endpoints.response: 200 {ok:true, html, entry, bytes, styleError, ...} | {ok:false, errors, durationMs} (bundle failure is not an HTTP error); 400/413/500 {error}.
endpoints.notes: No model call — pure esbuild over a virtual filesystem.

endpoints.purpose: Runs the real tsc against in-memory project files and returns typed diagnostics.
endpoints.response: 200 {revision, completed, ok, issues, diagnostics, truncated, checked, durationMs}; 400/413/500 {error}.
endpoints.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8050/api/typecheck -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"projectId":"build-123-check","files":{"src/App.tsx":"export default function App(){return null}"}}'
endpoints.notes: Mounted at /api/typecheck, router path '/'. Cancels the tsc run on client disconnect.

endpoints.purpose: Mints a CSRF state nonce and redirects to Google's OAuth consent screen.
endpoints.request: None — any incoming state is ignored.
endpoints.notes: Exempt from the /api auth gate.

endpoints.purpose: Validates state, exchanges the code, fetches the profile, checks ALLOWED_EMAILS, issues the session cookie.
endpoints.response: 302 to successRedirect with multi_app_session cookie (7-day) | 400 (state mismatch/missing code) | 403 (not allowlisted) | 500.
endpoints.notes: The state cookie is cleared before anything else can fail, making the nonce single-use even on a failed exchange.

endpoints.purpose: Reports whether the request carries a valid session and, if so, the user's profile.
endpoints.request: Reads the session cookie or an Authorization: Bearer header.
endpoints.notes: This route's own middleware never rejects; the actual 401 for an unauthenticated caller comes from the app-wide /api gate, not this handler.

endpoints.purpose: Clears the session cookie.
endpoints.notes: Stateless JWTs are not revoked server-side — only the browser's cookie is cleared.

endpoints.purpose: Mints a CSRF state nonce and redirects to GitHub's OAuth authorize page.
endpoints.notes: Only mounted when GITHUB_CLIENT_ID/SECRET are set; refuses to construct without ALLOWED_GITHUB_USERS.

endpoints.purpose: Validates state, exchanges the code for a token, fetches the profile, checks ALLOWED_GITHUB_USERS, issues the shared session cookie.
endpoints.notes: Issues sessions under the identical cookie name and JWT secret as Google — indistinguishable to requireAuth.
